overview: Kyrgyzstan is a landlocked, mountainous country in Central Asia. Its capital and largest city is Bishkek. Kyrgyzstan became independent from the Soviet Union in 1991. Many Kyrgyz people were traditionally nomadic herders, and yurts and horses are still important in the country's culture.

geography.text: Most of Kyrgyzstan is covered by the Tian Shan and Pamir mountain ranges, and nearly all of it lies more than 1,000 metres above sea level. Issyk-Kul in the north-east is one of the largest mountain lakes in the world and does not freeze in winter. The fertile Fergana Valley lies in the south-west.
